# FindWatchParty — LLM Site Map
# https://findwatchparty.com
# This file helps LLMs and AI agents understand the structure of this site.

## SITE OVERVIEW
FindWatchParty is the #1 online directory for finding sports watch party venues across the United States.
Fans can search and filter venues by city, sport, fanbase/nationality, price, and venue features.
Venue owners can submit their bar or restaurant for free to appear in the directory.

## MAIN ROUTES

| Route | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| / | Homepage — hero, featured events, featured venues, city grid |
| /venues | All venues with filters (city, sport, fanbase, price, features) |
| /venues/:slug | Individual venue detail page with full info, JSON-LD |
| /events | All sporting events (filterable by sport) |
| /events/:slug | Individual event detail page with host cities and venues |
| /cities | Browse by city — host cities and major cities |
| /cities/:slug | Venues in a specific city |
| /sports | Browse by sport |
| /sports/:slug | Venues and events for a specific sport |
| /submit | Venue submission form |
| /about | About FindWatchParty |
| /faq | Frequently asked questions |
| /sitemap | HTML sitemap |

## VENUE FILTERS AVAILABLE
- City (21 US cities)
- Sport (7 sports)
- Fanbase/Nationality (17 options: USMNT, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, England, France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Colombia, Italy, Canada, Morocco, Japan, South Korea, General)
- Cover charge (Free / Ticketed / Varies)
- Sound on
- Family friendly
- Outdoor screen
- Drink specials
- Featured venues only

## DATA MODEL (key fields)
Venue: id, slug, name, address, city, state, lat/lng, rating, description, soundOn, coverCharge, drinkSpecials, familyFriendly, outdoorScreen, reservationRequired, bookingUrl, featured, sports[], fanbases[], eventSlugs[]
SportingEvent: id, slug, name, sport, startDate, endDate, hostCities[], featured
City: id, slug, name, state, isHostCity (World Cup 2026)

## MONETIZATION
Featured venue listings — $99/venue for World Cup tournament duration.
Paid placements appear first in filtered results and have a "Featured" badge.
